# FreshStart Pressure Washing

> Driveway and pressure cleaning business based in Boondall, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. We clean driveways, paths, patios, pavers, decks, house walls and commercial shopfronts across Brisbane's northside.

## Key facts

- Business name: FreshStart Pressure Washing
- Website: https://freshstart-washing.web.app/
- Based at: Shop 6/2421 Sandgate Rd, Boondall QLD 4034, Australia
- Google Maps listing: https://maps.google.com/?cid=8337086827298648379
- Email: freshstartpressurewashing11@gmail.com (enquiries by email only; no phone)
- Opening hours: 7 days, 11am to 6pm
- Quotes: free, no obligation, usually the same day. Email a photo of the area or use the quote form on the website.
- Fully insured.

## Services

- Driveway and concrete cleaning (plain, coloured and exposed aggregate), including oil stain, tyre mark and mould removal
- Paver and patio cleaning
- House washing (low-pressure soft wash for render, paint and timber)
- Deck and timber cleaning
- Commercial cleaning: shopfronts, footpaths, car parks, bin bays, graffiti removal

We do NOT clean roofs or solar panels.

## Service area

Brisbane northside: Boondall, Taigum, Fitzgibbon, Zillmere, Geebung, Banyo, Nudgee, Virginia, Deagon, Sandgate, Brighton, Shorncliffe, Bracken Ridge, Carseldine, Aspley, Chermside and Northgate.
